unit_definition.fact: A unit is one FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef with its class-qualified name; nested function definitions are walked inside their enclosing unit's sweep.

analysis_boundaries.walk: Both sweeps (tools/gates/astscan.py) analyse ast.walk over one unit's node: intra-unit control flow, nested defs included.
analysis_boundaries.ends_at: A call to a sibling or helper unit is not followed; state established or observed in the callee is invisible to the caller's sweep and vice versa.

connecting_paths.derivation: Mechanically countable as same-file call edges between corpus units: for every corpus unit, calls whose name matches another unit of the same file. Re-derived by tests/tooling/gates/test_b0f_method.py against the current corpus; the count must be greater than zero for the gap to matter, and it is.
connecting_paths.cross_file_note: Cross-file edges exist additionally via imports; the same-file count already suffices to establish that connecting executable paths are common.

other_checks_examined.scope: per declared function, first assertion in that function's own body

other_checks_examined.check: empty-set rule at runtime (tools/gates/emptyset.py, engine aggregations)
other_checks_examined.scope: the engine's own cross-module aggregations at run time; not a static property of arbitrary test/validator units
proof-named consumer units are checked individually where a category claim spans units; this follows declared proofs, it does not discover undeclared cross-unit flows

minimal_case.fact: An exception injection moved into a helper called by the test yields zero sweep candidates, while the semantically identical inline form yields one; the connecting call edge is exactly the boundary at which the analysis ends.

consequence.status: genuine follow-up blocker for a later method decision
consequence.not_resolved_by: documentation alone; this record classifies the boundary, it does not accept it
consequence.out_of_scope_here: a general interprocedural or whole-program analysis is explicitly outside block B0f
